description: Concatenate an ordered list of already-uploaded video and/or still-image segments (all from get_upload_url) into one continuous, fresh-encoded output. Same segment shape, slate/bumper/end-card/insert use cases, and options as conform_splice_from_url — use for local files or files too large to fetch by URL. Poll get_job_status until 'complete', then get_download_url.

options.description: Same options object as conform_splice_from_url (width, height, framerate, bitrate, audio_bitrate, h264_profile).

segments.description: Ordered list of segments, played in array order. At least one must be type 'video'.

duration_seconds.description: Required for type 'image': how long the still holds, in seconds (0.5–60). Ignored for type 'video'.

object_key.description: The object_key returned by get_upload_url for this segment's source file.

name: conform_splice_media

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job. Pass to get_job_status and get_download_url.
